name: bun-plugin-react-native-testing-library
description: Bun runtime plugin that makes @testing-library/react-native work under bun test with zero Jest and zero Metro

scripts.test: bun test --bail test/unit test/property test/contract test/example-app
scripts.test:all: bun test --bail test/unit test/property test/contract test/example-app test/integration
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --bail --coverage test/unit test/property test/contract test/example-app
scripts.test:soak: RN_BUN_FC_RUNS=100 bun test --bail test/unit test/property test/contract test/example-app
